elena (product): Quick announcement: launching a preview of the Private KMS rotation replay tool for VPC/on-prem customers. Opt-in preview window: 2026-04-01 -> 2026-04-08.

elena (product): Short description: lets customers simulate a managed CMK rotation against a staging copy to detect client-side compatibility issues before committing a live rotation. Does not unwrap customer key material.

marta (eng-security): Technical note: replay runs in an isolated namespace, never touches live plaintext, and tags audit entries with `kms.replay`. Replay audit entries are stored in a separate index (preview retention: 60 days).

sam (eng-infra): Can customers trigger this from CI? What's the API?

elena (product): Yes. REST + SDK supported. Example: POST /private/v1/kms/{tenant}/replay?mode=staging with a bearer token. Preview docs available behind SSO at https://console.internal/redwood/private-kms-replay (link in the private docs space).

cj (customer-success): Customer outreach: recommend we offer replay sessions proactively to any customer planning rotations in the next 90 days. I'll draft invite templates and a post-replay checklist.

amy (privacy): For compliance, does replay produce the same audit footprint as a real rotation? Legal will want to see formats.

marta (eng-security): Replay audit entries mirror rotation entries but include `replay=true` and live in the segregated export index. We also provide an export bundle (sample JSON + schema) so compliance teams can ingest.

sam (eng-infra): Clarification: do we store any unwrapped key material for the replay?

marta (eng-security): No. Replays operate on wrapped key blobs supplied by the customer. Redwood never unwraps or permanently stores raw key bytes.

elena (product): Rollout plan: 1) internal alpha with red-team + 3 pilot customers (Apr 1-2) 2) invite-only preview opens Apr 3 3) feedback window Apr 3-8 4) GA decision meeting Apr 15.

elena (product): Action items: eng-infra: provision preview namespaces + stabilize endpoint (sam). eng-security: finalize audit export and tags (marta). customer-success: coordinate pilot invites & comms (cj). privacy/legal: review export bundle (amy).

sam (eng-infra): I'll provision preview namespaces today. Expect a brief sub-second hook attach during deployment. Will post CI links.

ops-bot: Deployment queued: `replay-preview-v1` -> cluster-private-staging. Track: https://ci.internal/builds/98765 (status: queued).

cj (customer-success): I'll prepare two templates: "KMS rotation replay invite" and "Post-replay checklist" and share in #customer-success-docs by EOD.

amy (privacy): Please include a note that replay audit logs are segregated and provide the export sample for legal review.

marta (eng-security): Adding sample export schema to preview docs now.

sam (eng-infra): Pilot tech note: example curl:
`curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://private-api.redwood/v1/kms/tenants/{tenant}/replay -d '{"target":"staging"}'`

marta (eng-security): Pilot security checklist: enforce MFA for admin accounts, enable SIEM forwarding, rotate replay service creds after each session.

cj (customer-success): I'll make SIEM forwarding a precondition for pilot enrollment.

sam (eng-infra): Deployed preview hooks to private-staging; verified `kms.replay` tags flow to test index.

ops-bot: Deployment succeeded: `replay-preview-v1` -> private-staging. Build 98765 -> success.

marta (eng-security): Uploaded sample export JSON + schema to the docs page.

elena (product): Thanks everyone. If pilots go well we'll make a GA recommendation on Apr 15. Ping me directly for blockers. :rocket:
